visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long hair, wearing a brown puffer jacket, a grey-brimmed black cap, and sunglasses, stands in an outdoor street setting. An interviewer's hand holds a yellow microphone labeled 'HahaTai' near him. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The man looks slightly off-camera as text overlays '有種來抓我' (Catch me if you can) and '做音樂' (Make music) appear. The background shows a blurry urban street with trees and traffic signs. (3) The man holds a smartphone and the microphone, performing a rap. Large white captions like '每天' (Every day) and '看到不同鳥事' (Seeing different bad things) appear rhythmically over his chest area. (4) A second young man in a black jacket and black baseball cap appears in a different outdoor location with stairs and green bushes. He smiles and laughs during a conversation. (5) A grayscale filter is applied to a close-up of the second man during a 'flashback' segment labeled '尬聊回顧'. He has a slightly awkward smile while touching his chest.

(14) [Subtitle]: 答案是三是假的. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以你是做音樂的. (16) [Subtitle]: 你是做什麼音樂. (17) [Subtitle]: 饒舌. (18) [Subtitle]: 你的藝名是什麼. (19) [Subtitle]: Nick. (20) [Subtitle]: 哦跟周湯豪一樣.
